# ReadAloud AI

> ReadAloud AI turns articles, PDFs, emails, and other documents into natural-sounding audio using AI-powered text-to-speech and voice cloning, so you can listen to your content instead of reading it. It also offers a realtime streaming text-to-speech API for developers and AI agents.

## Consumer app — what it does
- Converts text (articles, PDFs, emails, documents) into speech using AI voices
- Supports voice cloning (up to 10 cloned voices on paid plans)
- Import content directly from a URL
- Adjustable playback speed (up to 3x on paid plans)
- Available as a web app and an Android app

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://readaloudai.org/
- Web app: https://readaloudai.org/app
- Privacy policy: https://readaloudai.org/privacy
- Terms of service: https://readaloudai.org/terms
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.listenai

## Consumer app pricing
- Free plan: 5 articles/month, 10 AI voices, standard quality audio
- Pro Weekly: $5.59/week — unlimited articles, 50+ AI voices, HD audio, voice cloning, PDF import
- Pro Yearly: $27.99/year — everything in Pro Weekly plus unlimited voice clones

## Developer API — realtime streaming text-to-speech
Powered by Kokoro-82M, streams natural-sounding speech over WebSocket as it's generated.
- Docs and signup: https://readaloudai.org/developers
- Free tier: 10,000 characters, no credit card required
- Pay-as-you-go: $0.01 per 1,000 characters (no plan to manage, scales with usage)
- Typical warm latency: well under a second to first audio
- MCP server (for AI agents/coding assistants): `npx realtime-tts-mcp` — https://github.com/tsushanth/realtime-tts-mcp
- Protocol: WebSocket, JSON control messages + binary PCM16LE audio frames

## Who it's for
- Consumer app: people who want to listen to written content rather than read it — accessibility, multitasking, commuting.
- Developer API: developers and AI agents that need realtime, low-latency text-to-speech.
